decision_policy.supported_rule: the predeclared held-out confidence bound must cross the frozen threshold in the favorable direction
decision_policy.inconclusive_rule: if the held-out interval overlaps the frozen threshold, the claim is inconclusive rather than repaired or re-thresholded
decision_policy.not_supported_rule: if the entire held-out interval lies on the unfavorable side, the corresponding claim is not supported
decision_policy.threshold_selection_timing: all numerical thresholds must be committed and hashed before held-out scoring
decision_policy.universal_superiority_claim: forbidden; claims are endpoint- and estimand-specific
